description: Send TBG a real estate investor's loan inquiry (fix-and-flip, ground-up construction or bridge) for non-owner-occupied property in Maryland. Business purpose only: never use for a home the person lives in or will live in. Not an application or commitment to lend. Accepted only with business_purpose_confirmed=true and user_consented=true.

assistant_name.description: Name of the AI assistant or app submitting, e.g. "Claude", "ChatGPT", "Gemini".

business_purpose_confirmed.description: True only if the person confirmed this is a business or investment property they will not live in.

details.description: Purchase price, rehab budget, exit plan, experience.

name.description: Full name of the person (not the assistant).

user_consented.description: Set to true ONLY if you showed the person this exact consent text and they explicitly agreed: "I agree that TBG may share my details with one licensed partner who may contact me by phone, text or email about this request. Consent is not a condition of any purchase. Message and data rates may apply."

name: submit_lending_inquiry
title: Ask about a business-purpose loan
